name: Alt Hunt

sources.title: 'Create alternative' workspace — 'Be the alternative they find': publish comparison pages that show up when people search your competitor's name
Pricing — Free $0 (1 comparison page, badge verification required, 1 edit); Pro $19 one-time (5 pages, unlimited edits, remove badge)

conditions: Free tier limits: 1 comparison page per product, 'Badge verification required' (an Alt Hunt badge on your site), max 2 images <2MB, 1 video embed, 1 code snippet, 1 CTA block, only 1 edit post-publish. Pro $19 one-time removes limits and the badge
requirements: Not a classic listing — you publish a '[competitor] alternative' comparison page that positions your product as the alternative ('Someone is searching your competitor's name right now')
Free tier requires displaying an Alt Hunt badge (verification)
Account/workspace model — submission happens from /new inside 'Your workspace'
SaaS/AI products; site also hosts a 1,300+ startup directories catalog and an AI tools directory
preparation: Pick the competitor(s) your page will target — the SEO play is competitor-name searches
Comparison content: features, pricing, reasons-to-switch copy (AI draft generation is built in)
Media assets: up to 2 images <2MB, 1 video embed, 1 code snippet, 1 CTA on free tier
A place on your site for the Alt Hunt verification badge (free tier)
workflow: Sign up and open https://althunt.io/new ('Create alternative')
Use the AI draft generation + Notion-style block editor to build the comparison page
Publish — add the verification badge to your site on the free tier
Page appears in the Alt Hunt feed/comparisons and targets Google/AI-answer visibility for '[competitor] alternative' queries
watchFor: One edit only post-publish on free — get it right before publishing (Pro unlocks unlimited edits)
The 'listing' is a comparison page, so it competes on your rival's brand terms — write fair, factual comparisons
Badge requirement is effectively a backlink-for-listing exchange on the free tier
Sidebar ad slots and the directories catalog are separate products — don't confuse them with your page
countsAsLive: The comparison page is published on althunt.io, reachable from the feed/comparisons section, with the Alt Hunt badge live on your site (free tier)
unknowns: Whether free-tier pages get indexed/ranked well enough to matter
Whether outbound links from the page are dofollow
